compound epithet vāyu-vāhana with dative ending fused to namaḥ; salutation to one whose vehicle is wind
epithet gaṇḍalin with dative ending fused to namaḥ; salutation to one possessing a trunk

items.question: What divine attributes are honored through the salutations in this formula?
premises: vāyuvāhanāya names a deity whose vehicle is the wind
gaṇḍaline names a deity possessing a trunk
namaḥ marks reverential salutation to each named attribute
items.inference: The formula pays homage to a deity identified as wind-vehicled and trunk-possessing.
uncertainties: The specific deity intended by these epithets is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: \ Homage to the one whose vehicle is the wind; homage to the one who has a trunk.
